sprints.name: First deck
sprints.goal: PocketBase with 30 real Rexburg date ideas, a Vite and React app with its look and layout, a deck with Save and Hide, and a form that adds ideas to PocketBase.

sprints.name: Swipe, filter and ship
sprints.goal: Swipe to save or hide, filter by location and price, see your saved and hidden ideas, open an idea’s details, work well on phones, and put DateDeck online. The core app is done.

sprints.name: Accounts and AI
sprints.goal: Add sign-in so saved and hidden ideas follow each person, let people edit their own ideas, and add AI that suggests dates and helps write new ideas. Planned now so you can adjust it after sprint 2.

cards.title: DD-01 Set up PocketBase and the ideas collection
cards.story: As the team, we want a PocketBase database with an ideas collection, so that every part of DateDeck reads and saves the same data.
criteria: PocketBase lives in a pocketbase folder and runs on its own, without the React app
Ideas collection: title, description, place name, address, location area, price per person, duration, category and photo
Anyone can list, view and add ideas (we lock this down in sprint 3)
The collection is saved as migrations in the repo, so everyone gets the same schema

cards.title: DD-03 Build the IdeaCard component
cards.story: As a user, I want each idea on a card that shows what it is, where, how much and how long, so that I can decide at a glance.
criteria: IdeaCard React component that takes an idea as props
Shows photo (or a placeholder), title, place, location area, price per person (Free when 0) and duration
Works from 320px wide up
Shown with the ideas in src/data/sample-ideas.json; plain styles for now

cards.title: DD-05 Set up the Vite and React project on GitHub
cards.story: As the team, we want one repo everyone can run in minutes, so that we can all start building on day one.
criteria: First thing on day 1: push the empty Vite and React app and src/data/sample-ideas.json (5 ideas with the ideas collection fields) to main, so everyone can branch from it
README: how to run the app and PocketBase locally
Branch and pull request rules; main is protected
Lint and format setup so everyone’s code looks the same

cards.title: DD-07 Design the look and the app layout
cards.story: As the team, we want shared colors, fonts and a layout, so that every screen looks like one app.
criteria: Design tokens as CSS variables: colors, fonts, spacing, corners
App shell with header and Deck and Browse tabs
Mobile-first layout that also works on a laptop
A one-page style guide in the docs

cards.title: DD-02 Connect React to PocketBase
cards.story: As a developer, I want one simple way to load and add ideas from React, so that every screen uses the same data code.
criteria: A shared PocketBase client using the URL from .env
A useIdeas hook that lists ideas and adds a new one
Loading and error states the screens can show
A short example in the README

cards.title: DD-04 Show the deck with Save and Hide buttons
cards.story: As a user, I want to see one idea at a time and save or hide it, so that choosing a date is quick.
criteria: Deck component shows the top idea with two cards stacked behind it, using the sample ideas for now
Save and Hide buttons move to the next idea
Saved and hidden ideas are remembered in this browser, so they stay after a reload
Shows how many ideas are left, and an empty state when you reach the end
IdeaCard now uses the design tokens

cards.title: DD-06 Add an idea with a form
cards.story: As a user, I want to add a Rexburg date idea, so that the deck grows with ideas from people who live here.
criteria: React form: title, place, address, location area, price per person, duration, category and description
Clear messages for missing or invalid fields
Saves straight to PocketBase, and the new idea shows in the PocketBase dashboard
Clears the form and confirms it was added

cards.title: DD-08 Collect 30 Rexburg date ideas and load them
cards.story: As a user, I want real Rexburg ideas from the first day, so that the deck is useful right away.
criteria: 30 ideas from real Rexburg-area places, with address and location area
Every price range covered: free, under $10, $10 to $25, and $25 and up
Every location area and category has at least 3 ideas
Loaded into PocketBase with an import file the team can rerun

cards.title: DD-14 Open an idea’s details
cards.story: As a user, I want to open an idea and see everything about it, so that I can plan the date.
criteria: Tap an idea in the All ideas grid to open its details; close with a Close button or Esc
Details view: photo from PocketBase file storage (or a placeholder), full description, address, price, duration and category
Open in Maps link for the address
Works with both the sample ideas and real PocketBase ideas, so it doesn’t wait on DD-09
Built as its own IdeaDetails component, so the Liked list and sprint 3's Pick one for us can reuse it; fits a 375px screen

cards.title: DD-11 Swipe the card by dragging
cards.story: As a user, I want to swipe right to save and left to hide, so that DateDeck feels like flicking through a deck.
criteria: Drag past a set distance to save (right) or hide (left); short drags spring back
SAVE and HIDE stamps fade in while dragging
Works with mouse, touch and pen
Left and right arrow keys do the same
Built as its own SwipeCard component that wraps the top card and calls the deck's save and hide

cards.title: DD-09 Load real ideas with PocketBase filters and share saved and hidden ideas
cards.story: As a user, I want the deck to show real Rexburg ideas that fit my location and budget, so that what I see works for me. This is the groundwork card: every week 4 card builds on it.
criteria: First, by Tue Oct 20: give each tab its own page file (pages/Deck.jsx, pages/Browse.jsx, pages/Liked.jsx); Home.jsx keeps the header and switches tabs; nothing looks different and class names stay the same. Merge it so everyone builds in their own file
The deck and the All ideas grid load real ideas through useIdeas instead of the sample file, with loading, error and empty states
useIdeas accepts location areas, a price range, category and search text, filtered with pb.filter() queries in PocketBase, not in the browser
Results are sorted and paged so the deck stays fast
One shared useSwipes hook (provider in App.jsx) gives every tab saved, hidden, save, hide, unsave and unhide, still stored in datedeck.swipes
Filter state lives in Home.jsx and is passed to the deck and All ideas, ready for the filter bar in DD-13

cards.title: DD-16 Make it great on phones
cards.story: As a user on my phone, I want DateDeck to fit my screen and thumbs, so that we can pick a date anywhere.
criteria: Full-screen deck with the Save, Hide, Undo and Shuffle buttons in thumb reach
Header, tabs, the All ideas grid and the add idea form fit phone screens
Phone layout rules added to docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md (breakpoints, safe areas, grid and list patterns), so the week 4 screens follow them
No sideways scrolling at 375px; tested on an iPhone and an Android phone
Basic accessibility check: labels, focus and contrast

cards.title: DD-13 Build the location and price filters
cards.story: As a user, I want to filter by where and how much, so that I only see dates that fit tonight.
criteria: Location area chips and price ranges: Free, under $10, $10 to $25, $25 and up
Category chips and a search box
The deck and the All ideas grid update together, and Clear all resets them
Each option shows how many ideas match
Built as its own FilterBar component; fits a 375px screen with no sideways scrolling
Also add Save and Hide buttons to your IdeaDetails view from DD-14, using useSwipes from DD-09

cards.title: DD-12 Undo the last swipe and shuffle the deck
cards.story: As a user, I want to take back a swipe or mix up the order, so that a mistake or a boring order is easy to fix.
criteria: Back button undoes the last save or hide, whether it was a swipe or a button (add undo to useSwipes)
Shuffle reorders the ideas that are left
Hidden ideas never come back into the stack after a reload

cards.title: DD-10 Put DateDeck online
cards.story: As the team, we want DateDeck live on the internet, so that the class can use it on their phones.
criteria: PocketBase hosted on AWS with a persistent disk and HTTPS, and the React app on Netlify pointing at it
Netlify rebuilds the live app on every merge to main, so everything merged goes live on its own with no final deploy step
Public rules: anyone can view and add ideas, nobody can edit or delete from the app
Admin password is strong and backups are on
README deploy steps: how to apply new migrations and how to load the DD-08 ideas into the live database, so they go live as soon as DD-08 is merged
Smoke test on the live link from a phone: load, save or hide, add

cards.title: DD-15 Show my Liked (Saved) and Hidden lists
cards.story: As a user, I want to see the ideas I saved and the ones I hid, so that I can plan from my favorites and undo a hide.
criteria: A Liked tab beside Deck and All ideas shows the ideas you saved (photo, title, location and price), using the rounded card grid and design tokens
Heart buttons in Deck and All ideas toggle a like with an accessible pressed state; the Liked grid and the Saved for later sidebar update together
Unlike from the Liked grid or the sidebar removes the idea from both lists, without deleting the idea
Likes use useSwipes from DD-09 (the saved array in datedeck.swipes), keep hidden and other fields, and show a clear message if storage can't be read
Hidden list with Bring back, which returns the idea to the deck
Clear empty states that explain swiping and hearts, with an All ideas button
Works by keyboard with visible focus, and fits 320px and 375px screens using the phone rules from DD-16

cards.title: DD-17 Sign up and sign in
cards.story: As a user, I want my own DateDeck account, so that my choices follow me to any device.
criteria: Sign up and sign in with email and password using the PocketBase users collection
An auth context in React; signed-in state shows in the header
Sign out, and stay signed in after a reload
Ideas record who added them; only signed-in users add ideas, and only the creator edits or removes theirs

cards.title: DD-19 Ask the AI for a date idea
cards.story: As a user, I want to describe what I am in the mood for and get matching ideas, so that choosing is even faster.
criteria: A box where you type something like “cheap outdoor date for Friday night”
A PocketBase hook sends it, with the matching DateDeck ideas, to an AI API; the API key stays on the server
Shows 3 ideas from DateDeck with a one-line reason each, and Save buttons
Handles slow or failed AI answers with a clear message

cards.title: DD-20 Pick one for us
cards.story: As a couple that cannot decide, we want DateDeck to pick from our saved ideas, so that we stop debating and go.
criteria: Button on the Saved list picks one at random
The pick deals in on a card; Pick another never repeats the last one
Let’s do this one shows the details with Open in Maps

cards.title: DD-24 Accessibility and polish pass
cards.story: As a user who relies on a keyboard or screen reader, I want every part of DateDeck to work for me, so that everyone can use it.
criteria: Everything works by keyboard with a visible focus ring
Images and icon buttons have labels; text contrast is at least 4.5:1
Animations turn off with reduced motion
Accessibility score of 90 or more on the main screens

cards.title: DD-18 Keep saved and hidden ideas in your account
cards.story: As a signed-in user, I want my saved and hidden ideas stored in my account, so that they are the same on my phone and laptop.
criteria: A swipes collection linking user, idea and saved or hidden
Rules: each person reads and changes only their own swipes
On first sign-in, choices saved in the browser move to the account
Rules checked with two test accounts

cards.title: DD-21 Let the AI help write a new idea
cards.story: As a user adding an idea, I want help filling in the details, so that new ideas are complete and easy to read.
criteria: From a title and place, the AI suggests a description, category, price range and duration
Suggestions fill the form and stay editable; nothing saves until you press Add
Uses the same server-side AI hook as DD-19
Works normally when the AI is unavailable

cards.title: DD-22 Edit and remove my own ideas
cards.story: As someone who added an idea, I want to fix or remove it, so that my ideas stay accurate.
criteria: My ideas list for signed-in users
Edit reuses the add form, filled in
Remove asks first
Only the person who added an idea sees these buttons

cards.title: DD-23 Approve new ideas before they go live
cards.story: As the team, we want to check new ideas before everyone sees them, so that the deck stays useful and appropriate.
criteria: New ideas start as pending and only show to the person who added them
Admins approve or reject pending ideas in the PocketBase dashboard
The person sees whether their idea is pending, approved or rejected
Starter ideas are already approved
